info.name: Azure Monitor List Activity Log events

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: The ID of the target subscription.

params.name: $filter
params.description: Reduces the set of data collected. Must include a time range filter using eventTimestamp. Supports filtering by resourceGroupName, resourceUri, resourceProvider, eventChannels, status, subStatus, correlationId, and caller. Example: eventTimestamp ge '2024-01-01' and eventTimestamp le '2024-01-02'.

params.name: $select
params.description: Used to fetch events with only the given properties. Accepts a comma-separated list of property names.

items.docs: Provides the list of records from the Activity Log. The $filter parameter is required and must include a time range. Optionally filter by resource group, resource, resource provider, or event status.
